title: The Laplace Transform, Step Forcing & Convolution

sections.heading: The Laplace Transform, Step Forcing & Convolution Practice Exercises

questions.answer: Use the table (and linearity): \( \mathcal L\{3 t + \cos{\left(t \right)}\}=\frac{s^{3} + 3 s^{2} + 3}{s^{4} + s^{2}} \).

questions.q: Using the definition, \( \mathcal L\{e^{2 t}\}=\int_0^\infty e^{-(s-2)t}\,dt \) equals (for \( s>2 \)):
questions.answer: Evaluate the improper integral; the boundary term at infinity vanishes for \( s>2 \), leaving \( \frac{1}{s - 2} \).

questions.q: Using the definition, \( \mathcal L\{2 t\}=\int_0^\infty 2te^{-st}\,dt \) equals (for \( s>0 \)):
questions.answer: Evaluate the improper integral; the boundary term at infinity vanishes for \( s>0 \), leaving \( \frac{2}{s^{2}} \).

questions.q: The second-order linear homogeneous ODE \( f''(x) - 53f'(x) + 696f(x) = 0 \) has characteristic roots \( \lambda_1, \lambda_2 \). What is the trace sum \( \lambda_1 + \lambda_2 \)?
questions.answer: From \( \lambda^2 - 53\lambda + 696 = 0 \), the sum of roots is \( 53 \).

questions.q: If \( \mathcal L\{y\}=Y(s) \) and \( y(0)=1 \), find \( \mathcal L\{y'\} \).
